item.title: 无上者
item.description:
《无上者》

Nothing above Him,
Nothing below Him,
Nothing beside Him,
Nothing at all.
无物在祂之上，
无物在衪之下。
无物在祂之外，
全然无一物。

What you see my dear ones
Is loves Perfection
Come to awaken us, in Human Form
亲爱的，
你们看见的
是爱的完美示现
以人身来唤醒我们。

item.title: dont worry be happy
El Camino Interior
我心呼唤您
item.description:
This fine album of songs, produced by Heather Nadel, is the kind of sharing that Meher Baba’s sister, Mani Irani, excelled in during her lifetime. The album begins with the haunting melody- a chant of Meher Baba's Name. Janet Luck in a mellifluous voice sings to the Beloved a song that Mani composed. She is accompanied by Bobbi Bernstein on the piano.
这张精美的歌曲专辑由海瑟·纳德尔(Heather Nadel)制作，以分享美赫巴巴的妹妹玛妮·伊朗尼(Mani Irani)一生中最卓越的作品。这张专辑以令人难忘的旋律开头——一首吟唱美赫巴巴之名的圣歌。珍妮特·拉克用悦耳的声音为至爱唱了一首玛妮创作的歌。而芭比·伯恩斯坦则以钢琴为她伴奏。
